# mausVoice

> Voice typing for your own machine. Press a hotkey, speak, and mausVoice
> transcribes it, optionally cleans it up with AI, and delivers it to a
> supported focused field or the clipboard. No account, no subscription, built
> with Rust and TypeScript/React.

## Project

- **Name:** mausVoice
- **Site:** https://maus-inc.github.io/mausVoice/
- **Repository:** https://github.com/maus-inc/mausVoice
- **License:** AGPLv3
- **Maintainer:** Owie Emmanuel (https://github.com/Owie6789)
- **Package Manager:** pnpm@10.34.5 (Turborepo monorepo)

## Quickstart

```bash
pnpm install
cd apps/desktop
pnpm dev:mac        # macOS
pnpm dev:windows    # Windows
pnpm dev:linux      # Linux
```

Prerequisites: Node 20+ (`.nvmrc` pins v24), pnpm 10, Rust toolchain (Tauri v2), CMake for whisper-rs.

## Architecture

mausVoice is a Tauri v2 desktop application (Rust + TypeScript/React). The
"Rust is the API, TypeScript is the Brain" pattern places provider selection,
styles, prompts, and output routing in TypeScript (Zustand + Immer). Rust
handles native capabilities and safety checks for audio capture, keyboard
injection, updater, encryption, GPU enumeration, and filesystems.

```
User input / System events
        ↓
React + Zustand state (TypeScript)
        ↓
Repos resolve local storage and AI providers
        ↓
Tauri commands (Rust API bridge)
        ↓
SQLite, the local transcription sidecar, or external AI services
```

## Repository Structure

| Path | Description |
|---|---|
| `apps/desktop` | Tauri desktop app (Vite + React + Zustand) |
| `apps/desktop/src-tauri` | Rust API layer (native capabilities, SQLite, transcription sidecar bridge) |
| `apps/docs` | Astro + Starlight documentation site (the maintained, authoritative docs) |
| `apps/windows-installer` | Windows installer (Tauri) |
| `docs` | Loose architecture notes, release guides, and historical reference material |
| `packages/*` | Shared packages: `@maus-inc/types`, `@maus-inc/utilities`, `@maus-inc/voice-ai`, `@repo/agent`, `@maus-inc/desktop-native-apis`, `@maus-inc/desktop-utils`, firemix, shared-fonts, eslint-config, typescript-config, plus native pill crates and `rust_transcription` |
| `scripts` | Automation and helper scripts |
| `marketing` | Marketing site assets (fonts, images, vendor scripts) |

## Key Features

- **Live transcription:** Streaming nova-3 via Deepgram (default personal path),
  Groq `whisper-large-v3-turbo` (batch fallback), other API providers, or fully
  local Whisper (CPU/GPU) or ONNX models (CPU) with zero network calls for recognition.
- **AI cleanup:** Optional LLM rewrite (Groq default `openai/gpt-oss-20b`, also
  OpenRouter/OpenAI/Gemini/Claude/Ollama). Independent of transcription mode.
- **Cross-app output:** One hotkey delivers cleaned text to supported focused fields by paste or simulated typing, with a clipboard fallback.
- **Encrypted keys:** Deepgram & Groq API keys stored encrypted with
  XChaCha20-Poly1305. Rotatable in Settings.
- **Personal dictionary:** Custom names, jargon, and shorthand remembered
  across sessions.
- **Cross-platform:** Native builds for macOS (Apple silicon + Intel, universal),
  Windows (NSIS/MSI), and Linux (`.deb` and AppImage).

## API Keys & Configuration

Two optional keys entered in-app (Settings):
- **Deepgram** (streaming transcription): https://console.deepgram.com/
- **Groq** (LLM text cleanup): https://console.groq.com/keys

Keys are encrypted on disk. For fully offline use, leave both empty and use
local Whisper.

## Quality Commands

```bash
pnpm run build         # Build all workspaces (turborepo)
pnpm run lint          # Lint all workspaces
pnpm run check-types   # TypeScript type checking
pnpm run test          # Run tests
pnpm run format        # Prettier format (ts, tsx, md)
```

## State Management

Single Zustand store with Immer. Actions compose pure utility functions and
call into repos. In this build repos resolve to local SQLite storage and local
or API-backed AI providers.

## Important Patterns

- Keep provider selection, styles, prompts, and output routing in TypeScript. Rust owns native safety checks and must not duplicate those product decisions.
- Use `<FormattedMessage defaultMessage="..." />` for i18n (never pass `id` prop).
- Database migrations: `apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/db/migrations/NNN_description.sql`
- New Tauri commands: define in `commands.rs`, register in `app.rs` invoke_handler.
- Shared package changes require rebuild before downstream consumers see them.
